title: Protect edible crops during extreme heat
subcategory: Protect edible crops during extreme heat
summary: Reduce root-zone heat and water loss without trapping stagnant humid air.
steps: Check official heat forecasts and inspect containers that heat faster than ground soil.
Water the root zone before peak heat when soil is genuinely dry.
Use mulch and temporary shade cloth that still allows ventilation; do not wrap plants in plastic.
Move portable containers out of reflected wall or pavement heat.
Delay transplanting, heavy pruning and strong fertilisation until stress passes.
